subject: EdgeFabric private deployment: pre-deploy readiness checklist & handoff
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@edgefabric.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-eng@edgefabric.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deploy prep — want to align on handoff and checklist

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving this to the next stage with procurement and infra — ops has asked for a clear checklist and any network artifacts your team will need so we can schedule a maintenance window. High level asks from our side:

- A concise pre-deploy checklist we can run against our on-prem environment
- Network diagram with required egress/ingress ports and firewall rules
- KMS/HSM integration expectations and certificate formats
- A contact list for cutover and troubleshooting (on-call rotation)

Attached is our current network diagram (internal) — it may help you identify gaps. Can you confirm turnaround for a Redwood predeploy template and point persons for the handoff? We're targeting the week of 6/7 for a staged roll.

Best,
Samir
Director, Infrastructure
EdgeFabric Inc.

Attachments: ef-current-network.pdf (internal)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@edgefabric.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy prep — want to align on handoff and checklist

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We're prepared to deliver a tailored predeploy pack. I've attached the Redwood predeploy template (spreadsheet) and a concise network checklist PDF. Quick notes up-front:

- We'll need a VPC/VLAN mapping and a brief inventory of the candidate hosts (IP ranges + NIC types).
- KMS: we support key wrap via customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) or HSM; we need the wrapping public key and allowed key IDs before the cutover.
- Ports: outbound 443 to Redwood control plane endpoints, and intra-cluster 2200–2210 for our management agent. We'll include exact CIDRs in the diagram.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood sends filled template + explicit port/CIDR list (today).
2) EdgeFabric fills host inventory + confirms KMS option (by 6/2).
3) Joint validation call (30–45m) to review the diagram and firewall rules (6/3 or 6/4).

Who should I loop from your security/compliance team? If you prefer, we can run the validation over an invitation to a shared doc.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-predeploy-template.xlsx, redwood-network-checklist.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy prep — want to align on handoff and checklist

Marissa / team — tagging to confirm internal owners for the EdgeFabric handoff:

- Networking & firewall verification: Ben Carter (network infra lead)
- KMS/HSM integration + cert vetting: Karthik Iyer (security infra)
- Deployment orchestration + cutover ops: Stephanie Nguyen (customer deployments)

Ben — can you review the diagram Samir attached and the ports Marissa called out? If there's anything nonstandard (SR-IOV, jumbo frames, BGP peer requirements) flag now so we can capture in the template.

Also recording a recommended pre-check sequence for the call:
- Confirm VLAN-to-VPC mapping
- Verify NAT/Egress route for control plane (443) and static routes for management ports
- Confirm time sync/NTP policy and allowed NTP pools
- Certificate exchange procedure + fingerprint verification steps

I'll draft the calendar invite for the validation call after Ben confirms availability.

-steph
Principal PM, Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@edgefabric.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-31T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy prep — want to align on handoff and checklist

Samir — reviewed your diagram and the attached notes. A few practical items before the validation call:

1) Public endpoints: we'll need to whitelist these control-plane FQDNs (listed in the attached pdf). No static IP requirement if you allow outbound TLS to FQDNs, otherwise we can provide an IP range.
2) Management ports 2200–2210 are by default TCP; if you have UDP-only appliances let us know.
3) MTU: if you run >1500 MTU, confirm host NICs and we will test with a small batch in staging.
4) KMS: for HSM integrations we require a PKCS#11-compatible endpoint; if you use cloud KMS we will rely on key-wrapping via RSA/OAEP.

I'll be on the call on 2027-06-03 10:00 PT. Sending a calendar invite via Google — please accept and attach the final host inventory prior to the call.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on the cutover window.

Ben Carter
Network Infrastructure Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-controlplane-fqdns.pdf
